bridge.text: A troll lives under the stone bridge, and today it is awake. It climbs up onto the road, twice your height, and blocks the way.

fight.text: The troll swings a club the size of a tree. Each blow that lands costs 3 Stamina. You can run back the way you came, but turning your back costs a round: the troll gets a free swing as you go.

ran.text: You run, and you do not stop until the bridge is out of sight. You are alive, but the road on the other side will have to wait.

won.text: The troll topples into the river with a splash that soaks the far bank. The bridge is yours.
